title: DucklakeS3Credentials
description: Optional credentials and connection settings for DuckLake catalogs or data stored in S3-compatible object storage.

enabled.title: Enable IAM Auth
enabled.description: Use the default AWS credential provider chain.

awsAccessKeyId.title: AWS Access Key ID
awsAccessKeyId.description: AWS or S3-compatible access key ID.

awsSecretAccessKey.title: AWS Secret Access Key
awsSecretAccessKey.description: AWS or S3-compatible secret access key.

awsRegion.title: AWS Region
awsRegion.description: Optional region for AWS or S3-compatible object storage.

awsSessionToken.title: AWS Session Token
awsSessionToken.description: Optional session token for temporary AWS credentials.

endPointURL.title: Endpoint URL
endPointURL.description: Optional endpoint URL for S3-compatible object storage.

profileName.title: Profile Name
profileName.description: Optional AWS profile used by the credential provider chain.

assumeRoleArn.title: Role Arn for Assume Role
assumeRoleArn.description: Optional Amazon Resource Name of a role to assume.

assumeRoleSessionName.title: Role Session Name for Assume Role
assumeRoleSessionName.description: Optional identifier for the assumed role session.

assumeRoleSourceIdentity.title: Source Identity for Assume Role
assumeRoleSourceIdentity.description: Optional source identity for the assumed role session.
